DECIDE: Upgrade Verifier now fails at publish with npm E409. Verdaccio's default config proxies to npmjs where @chude/get-stuff-done@3.0.2 genuinely exists, so publishing the CURRENT version collides; the bumped 3.0.2-upgrade.<to> would not. Options: run verdaccio as a step with an uplink-disabled config (service containers cannot mount repo files), or publish the current step under a local-only version. The choice changes what the gate proves.

DECIDE: Perf Budget (windows) cannot pass until the trusted measurement-harness pin advances. The job runs measurement-harness checked out at pinned SHA 35cbe088, never PR head, so the fix in 5b45a921 is inert. This is a trust-boundary change touching 6 locations (3 in ci.yml including the --harness-sha binding-manifest arg, plus tests/ci-workflow.test.js, tests/paired-binding-manifest.test.js, tests/verify-hosted-ci.test.js).
